useModel.lowLevelNote: The low-level API uses Transformers step by step: load the processor, build the chat template, preprocess inputs, call generate, and slice the output. AutoModel* is a generic example; some architectures (e.g. Qwen, LLaVA) require their own model class.
useModel.dockerHint: Requires Docker with NVIDIA Container Toolkit configured.

steps.installHint: Run this once before first use.

download.title: Download Model
download.intro: Download this model to your machine with the commands below, in order.

upload.title: Upload Model Files
upload.intro: Upload local files to this model repository with the commands below.
upload.localPathHint: Replace it with the model folder on this machine, for example:

tooltips.cached: Every file of the default branch is stored in MatrixHub, so workloads download the files from MatrixHub instead of the upstream registry. MatrixHub still checks upstream for new commits.
tooltips.partial: Files that are not cached are fetched from the upstream registry on first download, at upstream speed.
tooltips.uncached: Files that are not cached are fetched from the upstream registry on first download, at upstream speed.
tooltips.running: MatrixHub is pulling this model from the upstream registry. The status updates automatically.
tooltips.failed: The last server-side pull failed, so files that are not cached are fetched from the upstream registry on first download.

hints.pull: To cache them in advance, click Download Model on this page and choose Pull to server.
hints.retry: To retry, click Download Model on this page and choose Pull to server.
hints.askToPull: Project members with the Admin or Editor role can pull the model to the server in advance.

method.label: Download method
method.serverDescription: MatrixHub pulls the model files from the upstream registry and caches them. No local environment needed.
method.cliDescription: Run the hf download command locally to download the model.

revision.label: Revision
revision.typeHint: Type a branch, a tag or a commit to pull another revision.

summary.scopeValue: All model files of the selected revision
summary.enterName: Enter the upstream model name to see which files will be pulled.

states.nothingToPull: This revision has no files to pull.
states.alreadyCached: All files of this revision are already cached and ready to use.
states.succeeded: Pull completed. All files of the selected revision are cached.

hints.server: The task keeps running on the server after you close this panel.
hints.cli: Refresh the page after the download completes.

errors.notFound: The model or revision was not found upstream. Check the name.
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to pull models into this project.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalidArgument: The request is invalid. Check the model name and the revision.
errors.failedPrecondition: The model cannot be pulled. It may require authorized access, the revision may not be on a branch or tag, or the revision may have too many files.
errors.unavailable: The upstream registry is unreachable. Try again later.

pollErrors.notFound: The model is no longer in MatrixHub, so its progress cannot be shown.
pollErrors.permissionDenied: You no longer have access to this model.
pollErrors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to see the progress.
pollErrors.invalidArgument: Failed to get the pull progress.
pollErrors.failedPrecondition: Failed to get the pull progress.
pollErrors.unavailable: MatrixHub is unreachable. Try again later.
pollErrors.unknown: Failed to get the pull progress.

delete.title: Delete Model
delete.warning: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the {{name}} model repository and all of its files, including weights.

set.label: Mark as featured model

set.error: Failed to mark model as featured

unset.label: Remove from featured models

unset.success: Model removed from featured models successfully
unset.error: Failed to remove model from featured models
